text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho,
the prelude to the Classic Triple Crown—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's goal is the Japanese Derby.
Underlying that is her deep, burning desire
to leave her mark on the Triple Crown path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then there is no way we can simply pass by the Satsuki Sho, the very first race of that journey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her body as it is "right now,"
she should be able to fight in the Satsuki Sho and carry that momentum
all the way into the Nippon Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...This tension can be felt even all the way back here in the waiting room.
So this is the atmosphere of a Classic-grade GⅠ race."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No problem.
Both mind and body are in top condition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I wish to achieve results in this 'Satsuki Sho' as well,
making it my first step toward surpassing my elder sister's shining trail.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Please, watch me.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The first race of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho.
It will be starting very soon!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (So this is the Satsuki Sho.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Feverish cheers, the suffocating presence of the runners,
and the heavy, oppressive atmosphere……――)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Within it, I can truly feel my own heartbeat.
A pulse that will not be swallowed up by this world—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...You stood on a stage like this too, didn't you, dear Sister?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: As expected of Ardan-san... Such incredible concentration—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still, even so, I will...!
I'll get results in this Satsuki Sho and carry that momentum straight to the Tokyo Yushun!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "...Both Chiyono O and Ardan seem to be in peak condition."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Especially Ardan-san...
Seeing it up close, that focus of hers really is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"A worthy opponent, indeed!
However—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I find it somewhat objectionable to be deemed beneath your notice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I will strike you with it.
My running, right before your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: In order to surpass the brilliance of the crown jewel—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan, heading out.
